body.heading: What is a pattern?
paragraphs: A pattern is something that repeats in an order you can predict: stripes on a shirt, tiles on a floor, steps on a staircase.
Once you can guess what comes next, you have found a pattern. Your home is full of them, hiding in plain sight.

body.heading: Hunt together
paragraphs: Walk around one room with your adult and point at every pattern you can find. Check curtains, carpets, blankets, books, and even the fruit bowl.
Draw your favourite pattern in your notebook. Try to copy the repeating part exactly.

body.heading: Make a pattern trap
paragraphs: Make a pattern with spoons and forks, or with coloured socks: spoon, fork, spoon, fork. Then secretly remove one piece.
Can your adult spot the gap? Swap roles and let them set a pattern trap for you.

description: For ages 6–9 with an adult: hunt for repeating patterns hiding in your home, then set pattern traps.
